notes: Only Rustam sees Crypto tab placed immediately after Financial Literacy in Finances; server requires authenticated Rustam role.
Read-only Bybit API key validation and AES-256-GCM encryption at rest; Bybit Unified balances, asset breakdown and unrealized PnL.
Public Ethereum Mainnet addresses read ETH and supported ERC-20 balances, plus live onchain Uniswap V3 NFT liquidity position values and range status.
Cached automatic refresh (15 minutes), manual refresh cooldown (one minute), and saved daily USD portfolio snapshots.
Totals are withheld when asset valuation is incomplete; Bybit Funding, other networks and unsupported assets are explicitly excluded.
Prepared on feature branch with no deployment; API route reuses existing api/index.js serverless entrypoint.
versionPolicy: Крупное обновление: следующий целый номер. Мелкое обновление: следующий десятичный номер. Один пакет изменений = один production deploy.
